verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents several event-driven automation mechanisms. Adaptive triggers [docs-26] and guarded rollouts [docs-5] change flag state automatically. Progressive rollouts [docs-4] and scheduled flag changes [docs-35] advance releases without manual steps. Webhooks [docs-38] send events to external systems. However, the evidence is mostly titles with no detail, and the automation appears limited to flag and release actions rather than a general rule-to-action engine. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how trigger conditions and actions are defined, user-defined event-to-action rules beyond flag state changes, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
